In-class Discussion and Activities#
Students need to identify the issues and problems in various studied cases and actively participate in class activities and discussion.
Students are permitted to use Generative AI tools in information searching; however, they are strictly prohibited from using AI to write any part of their assessment reports.

Group Project: 
Students are divided into groups (3-5 students for each group). Each group is required to examine the application of AI in accounting area. In addition, each group is required to make a presentation.
Students are required to properly acknowledge the use of GenAI tools, and provide explanation of why the piece of response from the GenAI tool is adopted.
